## Q4 2025 Quarterly Reports: Key Findings Summary

The search results cover a wide range of Q4 2025 reports across multiple industries. Here are the highlights:

---

### 📊 Corporate Performance
- **Unnamed Tech Company** posted $4.2B revenue (15% YoY growth), 28% operating margin, 45M active users, and $350M monthly recurring revenue, with Q1 2026 guidance of $4.4–$4.6B
- **SAP** reported record cloud backlog of €77B (30% growth), with AI driving two-thirds of Q4 cloud orders
- **CBRE** grew revenue 12% to $11.6B in Q4, with full-year 2025 revenue reaching $40.6B
- **Ondas Inc.** achieved 605% YoY revenue growth, targeting $375M+ in 2026
- **Cameco** saw annual uranium earnings rise $50M YoY, with strong Westinghouse contributions

---

### 💰 Financial Markets
- **US Direct Lending** hit $380B in full-year volumes, one of its strongest years
- **UK Commercial Property** investment surged 78% quarter-on-quarter to £17.5B
- **Crypto VC funding** jumped ~77% QoQ to $8.5B despite crypto prices falling ~24%
- **M&A activity** slowed to a two-year low of 1,478 deals in business services

---

### ⚡ Energy
- **Australia's NEM** hit a landmark milestone — renewables supplied over 50% of energy needs for the first time, with wholesale prices dropping 44% YoY to $50/MWh
- Wind generation rose 29%, battery discharge nearly tripled, and coal generation hit an all-time quarterly low

---

### 📈 Digital Marketing
- **Retail media ad spend** grew 33% YoY — the largest single-quarter increase in six years
- Nearly two-thirds of advertisers now use generative AI in retail media, shifting from creative tasks toward strategic planning

---

### 🏢 Real Estate (Dallas-Fort Worth)
- Office leasing activity **declined 31.7%** quarter-on-quarter
- Vacancy held steady at 25.3%, while Class A rental rates hit a record **$36.20/sq. ft.**

---

### 🌍 Economic Sentiment (UK)
- UK businesses reported **weakening demand, rising costs, and cautious confidence** heading into 2026
- Labour costs, skills shortages, and post-budget uncertainty were the dominant concerns in both Thames Valley and South West regional surveys

---

### 📡 Ireland Telecom (ComReg)
- FTTP broadband reached **59% of fixed lines**, with gigabit broadband available at 90% of all premises
- 5G subscribers grew **43% YoY** to 2.8 million

---

**Overall Theme:** Q4 2025 reflected a mixed but largely resilient global economy — strong tech, energy transition, and digital ad growth contrasted with cautious business sentiment in the UK, slowing M&A, and uneven real estate recovery.
